crossRefs.note: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship, and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would…
Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners…

people.name: Adriatic_Sea
people.line: The sea where Paul's ship drifted during a storm.

translations.web: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.
translations.bsb: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea. About midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.
translations.kjv: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
translations.asv: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven to and fro in the sea of Adria, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some country:
